plan.summary: BRO-5089 sweep part 9/11 (apply after the bro-5080 plans): clear Broadway historical posters of other productions/shows (two-model agreement, theatre renames accounted for) and historical synopses that are producer copy, another staging's production history, another work or invented plot. No noReliableArt marker: the verified image pipeline may refill.
